---
title: "Trends"
---

What moved from version to version: the Analysis Catalog by version — its Stores
and listed Analyses, and the counts by Association Coverage, Assigned Ancestry,
outcome type and trait class — the yardstick's measures across results, and the
test time each epic's record carries.

**This page is generated at render time** by
[`src/project_site/pages.py`](../src/project_site/pages.py) from the collected
catalog versions, the yardstick results under `docs/_yardstick/` and the epic
records; the render replaces this file. Run `pixi run site-data` and then
`pixi run site` to see it. A measure no run has taken yet says so rather than
appearing as a zero.
